title: Listen To Your Gut
subtitle: Trust it, trust her! Trust ... him?

items.text: Listen To Your Gut
With the help of Eagle, a massive Rube Goldberg machine begins to take shape.
The intricate machinery expands into the depths of the plant, with a dizzying amount of complexity.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hmm, you know, it's not exactly what I had planned originally, but it shouldn't adversely affect the results.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Uh, speaking of, mister—I wanted to ask ...

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Why does a smoke purification device need so many ... um ... explosives?

items.speaker: X
items.text: You're impeccably perceptive for an intern.
He blinks at her, and turns back to appreciate his masterpiece.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Don't worry about it, we're just recycling the base components from the explosives.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: So, are we done? Maybe we can go back as soon as—

items.speaker: X
items.text: —just need to adjust the circuit here. Hmm? Sorry, what did you say?

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Are we going back?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Sure, sure. Where else could we go if not back?

items.speaker: X
items.text: And of course, I won't forget about your recommendation letter when I get back.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: ...! Yes, sir! Thank you, sir!

items.speaker: X
items.text: You're welcome, but before that ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: Would you mind providing me with that unit we extracted from the "Purification Master 2.0."

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Got it!
Eagle hands him the unit. X kneels down, comparing it to the blank space on the machine.

items.speaker: X
items.text: —that won't do. It's the size isn't compatible.

items.speaker: X
items.text: This would be the optimal use-case for Laplace's "All-in-One Tool Kit 5.0."

items.speaker: X
items.text: You didn't happen to bring one along, did you?

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Laplace?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hmm, what?

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Oh, nothing!

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: I was just thinking ... your parents are probably really worried about you. Maybe we should head back.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Ah—
As soon as she finishes her sentence, there is a sharp turn in the mood between them.
X stands, turning to her with the device still in his palm.
His mouth curves into a smile, but it doesn't seem so friendly anymore.

items.speaker: X
items.text: It'd be better for you to not concern yourself too much with that.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Now, shouldn't you go check on your other compatriots?

items.speaker: X
items.text: They've been lost in that maze a bit too long.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Hmm ...
Eagle paces back and forth near the entrance to the seam, there's no sign of the puppy.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: The seam is bigger ... I guess the Maze Net thing is fading.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Good thing no one's noticed it yet.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: I need to hurry up before they come.
The boy scouts are still stuck in their merry-go-round, circling one another over and over.
She nearly laughs at the sight, but is soon overwhelmed by a wave of guilt and awkwardness.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Maybe Xavier doesn't get along with his parents.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Or maybe it's something else.
She rubs her pocket watch; its metal shell is lined with scratches over a smooth surface.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: But no matter what, I shouldn't have spoken up like that.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: I should apologize. That is what a good scout has got to do.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Right.
Eagle looks back at the top of the plant, determined.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: I have to go back to Xavier.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hey, welcome back!

items.speaker: X
items.text: Perfect timing. We're all set, all we need now is the right vantage from which to enjoy it.

items.speaker: X
items.text: This chimney should work.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Mr. Xavier—
Half of his body is sunk into the chimney pipe.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Again, call me "X."

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Mr. X, be careful—

items.speaker: X
items.text: Shh. Save your words for the way back. Come on, the spectacle is about to begin.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: But—

items.speaker: X
items.text: Can you get up here on your own?

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Y-yes! Just need a second or two!
Completely unaware of what's to come, she climbs up the cement chimney and stands next to X.
Scout Manual, Essential Virtues, Article VIII: "Ask less, act more."

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hold on to something.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Yes, sir!

items.speaker: X
items.text: Alright. Then—

items.speaker: X
items.text: Let's get this show on the road.
TO BE CONTINUED…
